notes.title: PLEASE STOP CRYING 2!
notes.content:
Due to popular demand, and finally finding some free time to work, I am finally finished with chapter 2 of our beloved baby-sitting adventures! 

The game will come out sometime early march, so please wishlist! 

Thank you all for the support!
